themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: The far-right continues to dominate regional elections and governance discussions across Europe, with significant coverage in Germany, Italy, and Sweden. Parties like AfD, Fratelli d'Italia, and Sverigedemokraterna are positioning themselves for major electoral gains, reflecting a broader transnational trend of right-wing political ascendancy.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, with potential to form first far-right state government since WWII.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government celebrates record longevity, but faces internal coalition tensions and rising competition from Vannacci's party.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD seeks 12-14 ministerial posts in potential right-wing coalition, normalizing their influence despite past opposition.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Bardella clash over campaign strategies, with RN leading polls for the 2027 presidential election.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Immigration and border security remain central issues for right-wing parties, with parallel debates in Spain, Italy, and Sweden. The Ceuta migrant crisis and Sweden Democrats' anti-Islamization proposals exemplify this cross-national focus on migration as a defining political issue.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD proposes banning new mosques and halting municipal aid to Islamist groups in Gothenburg.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen proposes penalizing veil-wearing in public spaces, sparking controversy over religious freedom.

themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple countries are amplifying claims of media bias and digital censorship, framing themselves as defenders of free speech against perceived establishment suppression. This theme appears prominently in coverage from the US, UK, Germany, and Hungary.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration sues media outlets and tech platforms, accusing them of bias and censorship against conservative voices.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage accuses BBC and other media of bias, facing investigations over funding and campaign practices.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD accuses German media of bias, proposing reforms to public broadcasting and challenging media narratives.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian government investigates media organizations for alleged bias, proposing stricter regulations on digital platforms.

themes.title: Economic Nationalism and Trade Disputes
themes.blurb: Economic nationalism remains a dominant theme, with right-wing governments and parties across multiple countries engaging in trade disputes and protectionist policies. The US, Argentina, and Poland feature prominently in this cross-national economic conflict narrative.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS government challenges EU trade policies, promotes domestic industries, and resists foreign economic influence.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP advocates for protectionist policies in Norway's energy sector, resisting international climate agreements.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments and parties are increasingly using nationalist symbolism and rebranding public institutions to reflect their ideological priorities. This theme appears in the US, Hungary, Italy, and Poland, with each country implementing symbolic changes to assert national identity.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration renames Lake Ontario to 'Lake America,' issues coins with Trump's image, and rebrands federal programs.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian government rebrands public institutions, changes street names, and promotes nationalist symbols in public spaces.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government emphasizes nationalist symbolism in public ceremonies and institutional branding.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS government promotes nationalist symbolism in public institutions and historical commemorations.
